jobs.title: Director, Systems & Data Transformation
jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada’s premier engineering-driven specialty insurer—bringing deep technical expertise to help clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We blend specialty insurance with inspection, engineering, and technology-enhanced services to redefine what risk protection can be, with leading capabilities across areas such as cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, and IoT technology services.

Backed by Munich Re, one of the world’s most experienced and financially stable insurance and reinsurance groups, HSB Canada combines global strength with deep knowledge of the Canadian market. Building on a long legacy of innovation and technical excellence, we continue to evolve our capabilities to address modern and emerging risks—from cyber and artificial intelligence to connected technologies.

Primary Objectives

The Director, Systems & Data Transformation is accountable for shaping and executing HSB Canada’s enterprise systems, data, and digital transformation agenda. Acting as a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director translates business priorities into an integrated multi-year roadmap, leads complex cross-functional programs, and delivers measurable improvements in growth, customer and broker experience, operational effectiveness, decision-making, and risk management.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership for the transformation and optimization of the Guidewire ecosystem and its surrounding applications, integrations, data platforms, and controls, ensuring reliable and scalable support for policy, billing, claims, underwriting, and insurance operations.

The Director also leads the delivery of major business-facing capabilities, including Quote, Bind and Issue (QBI), underwriting workflow, digital experiences, enterprise data products, analytics, and responsible AI solutions, in close partnership with business, technology, operations, risk, and global stakeholders.

Success requires an enterprise-minded leader who can connect strategy, architecture, data, delivery, change management, and operational execution; build high-performing multidisciplinary teams; and establish the governance, partnerships, and performance disciplines needed to sustain transformation outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Portfolio Delivery
Define and maintain an integrated, multi-year systems, data, and digital transformation strategy aligned with enterprise priorities and target business outcomes
Own the transformation portfolio from business case and prioritization through delivery, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations
Establish portfolio governance, roadmaps, investment plans, budgets, resource capacity, milestones, benefits, and executive reporting
Manage cross-program dependencies, delivery risks, organizational constraints, and competing priorities; escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations
Define measurable outcomes and key performance indicators, using performance insights to continuously improve delivery and business value
Core Systems Transformation & Guidewire Leadership
Set the strategy and roadmap for the specialty insurance technology ecosystem, balancing modernization, resilience, scalability, security, cost, and speed to market
Provide accountable leadership for the Guidewire platform and surrounding applications, including architecture, configuration, integrations, data flows, environments, releases, and lifecycle management
Lead major core-platform initiatives, including ClaimCenter transformation, while maintaining service continuity, production stability, support readiness, and effective control design
Digital Insurance & QBI Transformation
Lead end-to-end delivery of Quote, Bind and Issue capabilities and underwriting workflow improvements in partnership with underwriting, product, operations, distribution, and technology teams
Establish a scalable, reusable QBI architecture that supports multiple specialty products, distribution channels, evolving underwriting models, and integration with core platforms
Champion underwriter-centered design, process simplification, automation, and adoption to improve experience, quality, and cycle time
Data Science & Responsible AI
Define and mature HSB Canada’s enterprise data and data science capabilities, including data strategy, governance, quality, architecture, platforms, and reusable data products
Partner with business leaders to identify and deliver AI use cases across underwriting, claims, operations, finance, and distribution
Ensure data and AI solutions are explainable, secure, measurable, and embedded into business processes and decisions
Operating Model & People Leadership
Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning business systems analysis, product and application leadership, data engineering, analytics, and data science
Define clear mandates, decision rights, accountabilities, delivery standards, and career pathways; create a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning
Develop workforce and sourcing strategies that balance internal capability, global partnerships, and external expertise while managing capacity and succession risk
Advisory, Change Leadership & Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor translating complex system and data topics into clear choices, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions
Build alignment across Canadian and global stakeholders, facilitate executive governance, and communicate progress, risks, investment needs, and realized outcomes with clarity
Lead organizational change and adoption for new capabilities, and bring external perspective, emerging practices, and market insight to continuously evolve HSB Canada’s business and technology environment

Qualifications

University-level education in computer science, business administration, risk management, or equivalent professional experience
8–12 years demonstrated experience in business, technology, or product roles; insurance or broader financial services
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving: ability to frame ambiguity, develop options, assess trade-offs, and drive to clear decisions.
Strong analytical capability: extracting insights from data and market research and translate them into strategy and action.
Multi-workstream leadership: proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel while maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder alignment.
Executive communication: ability to produce crisp, compelling materials and present complex topics simply and persuasively to senior audiences.
Strong P&C insurance (or broader financial services) product knowledge—coverage/wordings, underwriting appetite, pricing fundamentals, and regulatory considerations is an asset
Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

We are pleased to offer our employees great benefits and resources to support their mental, physical and financial wellbeing. These include:

An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development
A hybrid work environment that combines weekly in-office and remote days
A great compensation package including an annual company bonus
Competitive company-paid flexible health and dental benefits, starting on your first day
Flexible dollars provided by the company to put towards a Health Spending Account and/or Wellness Spending Account
Wellness program with tools and resources supporting your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing – on and off the job
Participation in the DC Pension Plan with a progressive employer contribution scale based on tenure starting at 4%, plus optional company match in the RRSP plan
Generous time off including vacation, personal days, unplanned time, Statutory Holidays and company-wide early closure half-days
Learning and development programs and resources, including unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Education Assistance Program, and reimbursement for professional fees
Employee Referral Program and Recognition Program

Our base salary range for this role is between $159000 to $186000 per year, plus an opportunity for an annual company bonus based upon a percentage of eligible pay. The salary estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for candidates hired in this position. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to internal equity.

This role is located in our Toronto office on 390 Bay St, and we operate in a hybrid work model. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We do not use AI in our recruitment process - applications are reviewed by our team to ensure a fair and personalized experience.

HSB Canada is committed to providing a work environment that is inclusive and free of employment barriers and discrimination. Accommodations will be made for qualified applicants with a disability throughout the recruitment process. If you receive a request for an interview and you have a disability which will require an accommodation to support your participation, please consult with Human Resources or contact hr@hsb.ca as soon as practical so that suitable accommodations can be arranged.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:

You help teams take full advantage of data and AI to achieve their business objectives. To do this, you work closely with business partners to understand their challenges, identify opportunities and align analytical efforts with the organization’s strategic priorities. You also conduct strategic monitoring of AI developments and market practices. Working with the sectors, you lead efforts to find opportunities based on business processes and take part in discussions on transforming them through AI. By doing so, you help the organization identify tasks that need improvement and processes that need to be redesigned More specifically, you will be required to :

Help business sectors create, prioritize and adopt AI opportunities, aligned with business priorities
Support business sectors as they develop their AI strategies
Act as the main point of contact for AI between the business sectors and the Office of Desjardins Group’s Chief Data and Analytics Officer
Monitor market trends and internal AI activity across business sectors and support functions to identify opportunities for analytics
Hold brainstorming sessions to explore process-focused AI opportunities in different business sectors to determine which AI projects to prioritize
Create project briefs for AI opportunities, defining the business objective, context, business value, data requirements and complexity
Conduct internal and external monitoring of AI developments and determine their practical implications for the strategy and business sectors
Work with business sectors to lead initiatives to identify AI opportunities across processes, activities and member and client journeys
Prepare clear analyses and recommendations for senior management and decision-making bodies.

jobs.title: Leader de pratique, Stratégie de l'intelligence artificielle-FR
jobs.description:
En tant que Leader de pratique en stratégie de l'intelligence artificielle, vous jouez un rôle clé au sein du bureau du chef des données et intelligence artificielle, en accompagnant les différents secteurs de l’organisation dans la génération, la priorisation et la mise en œuvre de leurs initiatives en analytique et en intelligence artificielle (IA). Votre mandat consiste à aider les équipes à tirer pleinement profit des données et de l’intelligence artificielle pour atteindre leurs objectifs d’affaires. Pour ce faire, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires d’affaires afin de bien comprendre leurs enjeux, d’identifier les opportunités et d’aligner les efforts analytiques sur les priorités stratégiques de l’organisation. Vous réalisez également une vigie stratégique sur les avancées en IA et les pratiques du marché. Avec les secteurs, vous menez des démarches de recensement des opportunités à partir des processus d’affaires et contribuez aux réflexions sur leur transformation par l’IA. Vous aidez ainsi l’organisation à repérer non seulement les tâches à améliorer, mais aussi les processus à repenser. Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires dans la génération, la priorisation et l'adoption des opportunités en intelligence artificielle, alignées avec les priorités d’affaires.
Accompagner les secteurs dans l’élaboration de leur stratégie en intelligence artificielle.
Agir comme le point de contact privilégié en intelligence artificielle entre le secteur d’affaires et le bureau du Chef des données et analytique Mouvement.
Réaliser des vigies sur les opportunités en IA sur le marché et à l'interne concernant l’intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires et fonction de soutien afin d’identifier des opportunités analytiques.
Mener des activités d'idéation d'opportunités en intelligence artificielle pour les secteurs d’affaires, basés sur les processus d'affaires afin de déterminer les meilleurs prochains projets en IA à mettre en œuvre
Structurer et documenter les opportunités en IA sous forme de fiches mandat en qualifiant l’objectif d’affaires, le contexte, la valeur d'affaires, les données et la complexité.
Réaliser une vigie interne et externe en IA et en dégager les implications concrètes pour la stratégie et les secteurs d’affaires.
Mener, avec les secteurs, des démarches de recensement des opportunités IA à partir des processus, des activités et des parcours membres et clients.
Préparer des analyses et des recommandations claires pour la haute direction et les instances décisionnelles.

Salaire concurrentiel et boni annuel
4 semaines de vacances flexibles dès la première année
Régime de retraite à prestations déterminées qui assure un revenu prévisible et stable durant toute la retraite
Régime d’assurance collective incluant des services de télémédecine
Remboursement des frais liés à la santé, au bien-être et à de l’équipement pour le télétravail

Expérience significative en stratégie d’entreprise, en transformation ou dans la conduite de dossiers transversaux au sein d’une grande organisation
Expérience significative dans la structuration d'enjeux complexes, la remise en question d'hypothèses et la formulation de recommandations claires et applicables

Expérience en analyse ou en transformation de processus
Connaissance du français nécessaire

jobs.description:
Join one of Montreal’s Top Employers in 2026. We are a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future.

The position at a glance

This role supports BNP Paribas’s mission by strengthening the risk management framework through robust model governance and independent review. The position aims to coordinate the North American model governance framework while ensuring alignment with global standards and regulatory requirements. The primary objective is to provide regional coordination and effective challenge to maintain the integrity of quantitative and AI models used across North America and the Group.

In detail

Lead the RISK IRC team in Canada by integrating activities into the global operating model to ensure coherent contribution to global priorities.
Supervise North American Model Governance by managing regional processes and reporting to address Canadian and US regulatory needs.
Coordinate with stream and technical review leads across multiple locations to allocate work and resolve escalations for consistent delivery.
Build collaborative relationships with model developers and senior management to provide effective challenge as a second line of defense.
Contribute to the development of model validation practices by promoting high standards and producing reports for management and regulators.
Manage the ongoing professional development of direct reports by providing continuous coaching and feedback to encourage growth.
Apply reasoned decision-making when addressing work challenges to provide practical solutions in complex environments.
Maintain accountability for following policies and procedures to ensure organized and accurate job performance.

The Strengths And Skills That Will Help You Succeed

Master’s Degree in Quantitative field
Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience, including senior responsibility for model governance, independent review, and regulatory engagement.
The knowledge of English is required.*
Strong quantitative skills in econometrics, statistics, or applied mathematics when performing model reviews.
Comprehensive knowledge of bank products and business practices to ensure accurate assessment.
Familiarity with model risk management practices and regulatory guidance to maintain compliance.
Effective written and verbal communication when presenting information to diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborative relationship building when working within a matrix environment involving various technical leaders.
People-manager responsibilities: Oversee the ongoing professional development of direct reports through coaching and feedback.
Given the vast majority of our clients, both internal and external, are based outside of Quebec and Canada, specific language requirements may apply. Professional working proficiency in French and English languages are required.

jobs.title: Director, Defense & Security - Marketing Strategy-EN
jobs.description:
The Director, Defense & Security Marketing Strategy is responsible for defining and leading CAE's global marketing strategy for the Defense & Security business. This role drives integrated go-to-market strategies that strengthen CAE's position as a trusted partner in training, simulation, mission readiness, and operational readiness for military organizations, government agencies, OEMs, prime contractors, and allied defense customers worldwide.

The incumbent leads global marketing initiatives across portfolio positioning, product marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), demand generation, digital growth, executive engagement, strategic events, and thought leadership. Working in highly regulated and complex B2B/B2G environments, the role focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes, including pipeline growth, account penetration, market share expansion, opportunity progression, and revenue impact.

As a senior leader, this individual manages a global multidisciplinary marketing team and collaborates closely with Business Development, Sales, Capture, Product Management, Engineering, Programs, Communications, Government Relations, and Executive Leadership to ensure market alignment, effective execution, and commercial success.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Positioning

Develop and execute CAE's global Defense & Security marketing strategy aligned with business priorities and growth objectives.
Define differentiated market positioning and compelling value propositions across CAE's defense and security solutions portfolio.
Translate strategic priorities into measurable marketing plans, investment decisions, and business outcomes.
Ensure consistent, technically accurate, and compliant messaging across all customer-facing channels.

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Leadership

Lead product and solution positioning, messaging strategies, and go-to-market execution across global markets.
Translate complex technical capabilities into customer-focused value propositions and sales enablement tools.
Partner with Sales, Business Development, Capture, and Product Management teams to support strategic pursuits, proposal efforts, and business growth.
Drive successful product launches and market readiness initiatives.

Digital Growth & Account-Based Marketing

Lead global digital marketing and demand generation strategies across web, automation, email, search, social media, and ABM programs.
Develop targeted campaigns that increase customer engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline growth, and revenue contribution.
Establish performance metrics, marketing KPIs, and reporting frameworks to measure effectiveness and ROI.
Leverage marketing technology, analytics, and customer insights to improve campaign performance and account penetration.

Industry Events & Customer Engagement

Lead CAE's participation in major defense, security, aerospace, and industry events.
Develop event strategies that support customer engagement, executive relationships, brand visibility, and business development objectives.
Measure event effectiveness through pipeline influence, customer engagement, and business outcomes.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing global marketing team.
Establish effective governance, processes, and priorities to support business objectives.
Build strong relationships across business functions and regions to drive alignment and execution.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, International Relations, or a related field. Master's degree is considered an asset.
15+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience in global B2B, B2G, defense, aerospace, technology, or other highly regulated industries.
Proven success developing and executing enterprise-level marketing strategies, including positioning, product marketing, digital growth, demand generation, ABM, thought leadership, and executive engagement.
Experience leading high-performing teams in complex global organizations.

Preferred Qualification

Strong understanding of defense and security markets, government procurement, capture management, and proposal environments.
Ability to translate complex technical solutions into compelling customer value propositions.
Experience working closely with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership.
Strong strategic thinking, executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, English and French.
Experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and performance measurement tools.
Results-oriented leader with a strong focus on growth, customer engagement, commercial impact, and team development.

Benefits

Group Insurance.
Telemedicine Employee and Family Assistance Program.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Group RRSP.
CAE Pension Plan/Defined Benefit Plan.
Sabbatical Leave.
Flex Time.
Enhanced Parental Leave.

At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. jobs.title: Director , eDiscovery- Technology Consulting
jobs.description:
Who We Are

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About the Role

This Director position is within FTI Consulting's Technology practice. FTI Technology utilizes modern review platforms for native document review and case management. Our practice primarily provides professional consulting services to corporations and law firms for coordinating document review and production using Relativity and/or Nuix Discover. The Director will be responsible for managing multiple aspects of specific client matters.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who:

Is technically minded - all our work requires thinking in a logical, mathematical way about processes and sets of data
Works flexibly with a variety of team members - we work on a variety of projects at the same time, each of which can be staffed differently
Is eager and excited to learn - a positive, open-minded attitude will ensure quality work and bodes well for long-term career development
Works hard - while we do innovate, everyone has regular assigned tasks that are part of the overall workflow and on which high quality client service depends
Enjoys solving the impossible - we often receive requests that require us to consider difficult questions and develop new processes

What You'll Do

Have responsibility for day-to-day activities of projects including interaction with other consultants, supervisors, and client personnel
Apply analytical skills and leverage existing methodologies to various client situations and practice disciplines and create novel, customized solutions to meet shifting client needs
Utilize logical reasoning skills to provide complete client service
Work to ensure a quality product and delivery of all work within established timeframes.
Introduce additional FTI services to clients as needs dictate
Provide superior client service in demanding, deadline-driven situations
Maintain professional image within the firm and project same to those outside the firm

How You Will Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required
6+ relevant experience utilizing eDiscovery technology (Relativity, Nuix Discover, and/or Reveal)
Ability to travel to clients and FTI office(s) as needed
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

Strong proficiency with Windows and related software, such as Microsoft Excel
Familiarity with Microsoft Access and SharePoint
Excellent communication and client interface skills

new_jobs.title: Director, Systems & Data Transformation
new_jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada’s premier engineering-driven specialty insurer—bringing deep technical expertise to help clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We blend specialty insurance with inspection, engineering, and technology-enhanced services to redefine what risk protection can be, with leading capabilities across areas such as cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, and IoT technology services.

Backed by Munich Re, one of the world’s most experienced and financially stable insurance and reinsurance groups, HSB Canada combines global strength with deep knowledge of the Canadian market. Building on a long legacy of innovation and technical excellence, we continue to evolve our capabilities to address modern and emerging risks—from cyber and artificial intelligence to connected technologies.

Primary Objectives

The Director, Systems & Data Transformation is accountable for shaping and executing HSB Canada’s enterprise systems, data, and digital transformation agenda. Acting as a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director translates business priorities into an integrated multi-year roadmap, leads complex cross-functional programs, and delivers measurable improvements in growth, customer and broker experience, operational effectiveness, decision-making, and risk management.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership for the transformation and optimization of the Guidewire ecosystem and its surrounding applications, integrations, data platforms, and controls, ensuring reliable and scalable support for policy, billing, claims, underwriting, and insurance operations.

The Director also leads the delivery of major business-facing capabilities, including Quote, Bind and Issue (QBI), underwriting workflow, digital experiences, enterprise data products, analytics, and responsible AI solutions, in close partnership with business, technology, operations, risk, and global stakeholders.

Success requires an enterprise-minded leader who can connect strategy, architecture, data, delivery, change management, and operational execution; build high-performing multidisciplinary teams; and establish the governance, partnerships, and performance disciplines needed to sustain transformation outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Portfolio Delivery
Define and maintain an integrated, multi-year systems, data, and digital transformation strategy aligned with enterprise priorities and target business outcomes
Own the transformation portfolio from business case and prioritization through delivery, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations
Establish portfolio governance, roadmaps, investment plans, budgets, resource capacity, milestones, benefits, and executive reporting
Manage cross-program dependencies, delivery risks, organizational constraints, and competing priorities; escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations
Define measurable outcomes and key performance indicators, using performance insights to continuously improve delivery and business value
Core Systems Transformation & Guidewire Leadership
Set the strategy and roadmap for the specialty insurance technology ecosystem, balancing modernization, resilience, scalability, security, cost, and speed to market
Provide accountable leadership for the Guidewire platform and surrounding applications, including architecture, configuration, integrations, data flows, environments, releases, and lifecycle management
Lead major core-platform initiatives, including ClaimCenter transformation, while maintaining service continuity, production stability, support readiness, and effective control design
Digital Insurance & QBI Transformation
Lead end-to-end delivery of Quote, Bind and Issue capabilities and underwriting workflow improvements in partnership with underwriting, product, operations, distribution, and technology teams
Establish a scalable, reusable QBI architecture that supports multiple specialty products, distribution channels, evolving underwriting models, and integration with core platforms
Champion underwriter-centered design, process simplification, automation, and adoption to improve experience, quality, and cycle time
Data Science & Responsible AI
Define and mature HSB Canada’s enterprise data and data science capabilities, including data strategy, governance, quality, architecture, platforms, and reusable data products
Partner with business leaders to identify and deliver AI use cases across underwriting, claims, operations, finance, and distribution
Ensure data and AI solutions are explainable, secure, measurable, and embedded into business processes and decisions
Operating Model & People Leadership
Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning business systems analysis, product and application leadership, data engineering, analytics, and data science
Define clear mandates, decision rights, accountabilities, delivery standards, and career pathways; create a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning
Develop workforce and sourcing strategies that balance internal capability, global partnerships, and external expertise while managing capacity and succession risk
Advisory, Change Leadership & Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor translating complex system and data topics into clear choices, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions
Build alignment across Canadian and global stakeholders, facilitate executive governance, and communicate progress, risks, investment needs, and realized outcomes with clarity
Lead organizational change and adoption for new capabilities, and bring external perspective, emerging practices, and market insight to continuously evolve HSB Canada’s business and technology environment

Qualifications

University-level education in computer science, business administration, risk management, or equivalent professional experience
8–12 years demonstrated experience in business, technology, or product roles; insurance or broader financial services
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving: ability to frame ambiguity, develop options, assess trade-offs, and drive to clear decisions.
Strong analytical capability: extracting insights from data and market research and translate them into strategy and action.
Multi-workstream leadership: proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel while maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder alignment.
Executive communication: ability to produce crisp, compelling materials and present complex topics simply and persuasively to senior audiences.
Strong P&C insurance (or broader financial services) product knowledge—coverage/wordings, underwriting appetite, pricing fundamentals, and regulatory considerations is an asset
Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development

Wellness program with tools and resources supporting your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing – on and off the job
Participation in the DC Pension Plan with a progressive employer contribution scale based on tenure starting at 4%, plus optional company match in the RRSP plan

Learning and development programs and resources, including unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Education Assistance Program, and reimbursement for professional fees
Employee Referral Program and Recognition Program
